params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream tokens via SSE.

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0). Overrides the response_length mapping.

params.name: max_tokens
params.desc: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: How long (in seconds) to keep the model loaded in VRAM after request.

endpoints.desc: Executes raw CEL (cluaiz Execution Language) scripts natively. Used for dynamic agentic logic.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"script": "return 42;"}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/cel/execute', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: Dynamic ecosystem execution. Directly calls an exposed FFI function inside a component (e.g. extension, plugin).

params.name: args
params.desc: Array of arguments to pass to the function.

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"args": ["query", 10]}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/execute/plugin_name/function_name', json=payload)
print(res.json())

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {
    "file_path": "/docs/architecture.pdf",

}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/ingest/file', json=payload)
print(res.json())

endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible text vector embedding endpoint. Generates dense mathematical vector embeddings using the local ONNX engine.

params.name: input
params.desc: Input text or array of text strings to embed.
params.default: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

params.name: encoding_format
params.desc: Format to return the embeddings in (float or base64).

params.name: user
params.desc: A unique identifier representing your end-user.

examples.title: cURL
Python (OpenAI Client)
examples.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url='http://localhost:8000/v1', api_key='sk-no-key-required')

response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="onnx-embedding",
    input="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
)
print(response.data[0].embedding)
